reserves.name: Russian-ruble reserve basket (deposits and short-term assets; allocation undisclosed)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Undisclosed reserve banks and short-term asset issuers

reserveReview.rationale: A7A5's transparency page describes one-for-one backing by Russian-ruble deposits, while section 4.3 of its terms describes a diversified basket of fiat deposits and short-term assets. The issuer does not reconcile those descriptions or publish current constituent weights, institutions, account terms, or a retrievable assurance artifact, so the complete reserve is represented as one unresolved aggregate.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Conflicting current issuer descriptions of the eligible Russian-ruble reserve envelope
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Reserve-bank identities, deposit and short-term-asset weights, instrument identities, account terms, custody, liquidity, and current assurance evidence are undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Russian-ruble reserve basket (deposits and short-term assets; allocation undisclosed)
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Issuer sources identify deposits and short-term assets but do not publish a current constituent split or instrument-level reserve schedule.

providers.name: Undisclosed reserve banks and asset custodians

custodyProfile.uncertainty: A7A5 refers to deposits and short-term assets but does not identify the institutions, asset custodians, jurisdictions, provider shares, segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation terms, or account restrictions.
